I imagine it is a bittersweet memory for you.|Thrawn, to Hera Syndulla|}} A [[Gender|male]] individual was the '''brother''' of the [[Twi'lek]] [[Hera Syndulla]]. He [[Death|died]] by [[19 BBY]], while he was still young. A design on the [[Syndulla clan|Syndulla family]] [[Syndulla Kalikori|Kalikori]] was included to memorialize him. After [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] took the [[Kalikori]] from the family in [[2 BBY]], he noticed the design and deduced its meaning when studying the totem. ==Biography== {{Quote|Brother? Him?''"
"''They all are.''"
"''You're lucky.|Hera Syndulla laments her brother while discussing Omega's relationship to the other members of Clone Force 99|{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}}}} [[File:Syndulla_Kalikori.png|thumb|right|220px|The Syndulla Kalikori included a design memorializing Hera's brother on the left side of the heirloom.]] The [[Syndulla clan|brother]] of the [[Twi'lek]] [[Hera Syndulla]] was a [[Gender|male]] who [[Death|died]] at a young age by [[19 BBY]]. A design on the left side of the the [[Syndulla Kalikori|Syndulla family Kalikori]] was included to memorialize him. In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], while attempting to enlist the help of [[Clone Force 99]] to [[Rescue on Ryloth|rescue]] her [[parent]]s, [[Cham Syndulla|Cham]] and [[Eleni Syndulla]], from the [[Galactic Empire]], Syndulla spoke with the young [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] and learned that the other members of her [[squad]] were her brothers, causing Syndulla to lament and tell Omega that she was lucky to have them. In [[1 BBY]],{{RebelsDate|410}} when Syndulla, who had since become a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[General]], was captured by the Empire on the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Lothal]], she was interrogated by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. During the interrogation, Thrawn, who had taken the Syndulla family [[Kalikori]] the [[2 BBY|year prior]]{{RebelsDate|305}} and studied it, noted that one element seemingly referred to a deceased brother, adding that he imagined his death was a bittersweet memory for her. Syndulla retorted by saying that Thrawn would never be worthy of holding or understanding the Kalikori. ==Behind the scenes== Hera Syndulla's brother was first mentioned in "[[Jedi Night]]," the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/jedi-night-episode-guide|text="Jedi Night" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} that aired on [[February 19]], [[2018]].{{SW|url=news/the-final-episodes-of-star-wars-rebels-begin-february-19-on-disney-xd|text=The Final Episodes of ''Star Wars Rebels'' Begin February 19 on Disney XD}} Prior to the episode's release, the brother was mentioned in a preview clip for the episode posted on [[February 16]] of the same year.{{Twitter|starwars|status/964533585112780800|Star Wars|quote=Grand Admiral Thrawn uncovers a tragic event from Hera's past in this clip from "Jedi Night." #StarWarsRebels returns with NEW episodes Monday at 9pm ET/PT on @DisneyXD.|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/A1WTr}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}} {{Imo}} *{{Rebels|Jedi Night}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{EncyclopediaCite|Freedom Fighters From Lothal and Other Characters}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Lothal Insurgency (2)}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ჰერა სინდულას ძმა }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Syndulla, Hera's brother}} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Syndulla clan]]
